result.instructions: Tools for Hetzner Cloud, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Hetzner Cloud data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run hetzner_cloud_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run hetzner_cloud_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run hetzner_cloud_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. hetzner_cloud_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: hetzner_list_servers
tools.title: List servers
tools.description: List the servers in the token's project, optionally filtered by name, status or a label selector. Hetzner Cloud: GET /servers.

name.description: Only the server with this exact name.

status.description: Only servers in this power state.

label_selector.description: Label selector, e.g. env=prod or env!=dev — Hetzner's filter idiom.

tools.name: hetzner_get_server
tools.title: Get one server
tools.description: Fetch a single server with its type, image, IPs, volumes, networks and protection flags. Hetzner Cloud: GET /servers/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_get_server_metrics
tools.title: Get server metrics
tools.description: Fetch CPU, disk or network time series for one server over a window. Hetzner Cloud: GET /servers/{id}/metrics.

tools.name: hetzner_create_server
tools.title: Create a server
tools.description: Provision a new server. THIS STARTS BILLING: the chosen server type is charged by the hour from the moment it boots. Call hetzner_list_server_types first to see prices, and hetzner_list_images for a bootable image. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers.

name.description: A unique name for the server (also its hostname).

server_type.description: Server type name, e.g. cx22. See hetzner_list_server_types.

image.description: Image name or id to boot, e.g. ubuntu-24.04.

location.description: Location name, e.g. fsn1. Defaults to Hetzner's choice.

ssh_keys.description: SSH key names or ids to authorise. Without one, Hetzner emails a root password.

start_after_create.description: Boot the server immediately. Defaults to true.

user_data.description: cloud-init user data to run on first boot.

tools.name: hetzner_poweron_server
tools.title: Power on a server
tools.description: Power on a stopped server. Returns an action id — poll it with hetzner_get_action. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/poweron.

tools.name: hetzner_shutdown_server
tools.title: Shut down a server
tools.description: Ask the guest OS to shut down gracefully via ACPI. Prefer this over a hard power-off. Note that a stopped server still costs money — only deleting it stops the bill. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/shutdown.

tools.name: hetzner_reboot_server
tools.title: Reboot a server
tools.description: Reboot a server gracefully via ACPI. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/reboot.

tools.name: hetzner_create_image_from_server
tools.title: Snapshot a server to an image
tools.description: Create a snapshot image from a server's disk — the safe thing to do BEFORE a risky change. Snapshots are billed for the space they use. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/create_image.

type.description: snapshot (kept until deleted) or backup (uses a backup slot). Defaults to snapshot.

annotations.title: Snapshot a server to an image

tools.name: hetzner_enable_server_backup
tools.title: Enable server backups
tools.description: Turn on automatic backups for a server. This adds roughly 20% to the server's price. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/enable_backup.

tools.name: hetzner_disable_server_backup
tools.title: Disable server backups
tools.description: Turn off automatic backups for a server. Existing backups are DELETED. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/disable_backup.

server_id.description: The server to stop backing up.

tools.name: hetzner_change_server_protection
tools.title: Change a server's protection
tools.description: Turn deletion and rebuild protection on or off for a server. Turning protection ON is the safest write in this server. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/change_protection.
